name: Marshall County, IN
findings: Marshall County has 181 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marshall County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Marshall County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
